result: If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate extreme poverty. This would involve ensuring that every person has access to basic needs like food, clean water, shelter, healthcare, and education. By addressing poverty, we could reduce suffering, improve global health, enhance economic stability, and foster greater equality and opportunity for all. This change would create a ripple effect, empowering individuals and communities to thrive and contribute to a more just and sustainable world.
